'''Ojoon "Half-Face" Coi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] based at the [[Sriluur Guildhouse]] of the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]] who was active around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Coi earned his nickname as a result of injuries that he suffered during an encounter with a horde of hostile bugs.<ref name="The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett" />
